# CV Maker

> A free online CV and resume builder with role specific starting content, flexible editing, a live preview, and PDF, Word, or Markdown export.

CV Maker helps job seekers create structured professional resumes without creating an account. CV content is stored in the user's browser and exports are generated on request.

## Machine-readable content
- [Full Markdown guide](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/llms-full.txt): Public features, workflow, profession and role catalog, and policies. No JavaScript needed to read this guide.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/): CV maker overview and profession templates.
- [Templates](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/templates): Browse career categories and role based starting templates.
- [Features](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/features): Editing, preview, and export features.
- [How it works](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/how-it-works): CV creation steps.
- [Pricing](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/pricing): Free use, exports, and account requirements.
- [Contact](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/contact): Contact the creator at info@dhakalkiran.com.np.
- [Privacy policy](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/privacy): Data handling information.
- [Terms of use](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/terms): Service terms.
- [XML sitemap](https://cv.dhakalkiran.com.np/sitemap.xml): Crawlable public page URLs.

## Usage
Choose a profession, select a role where available, customize the sample content, review the live preview, and export the finished CV. Verify all personal details before sharing an exported document.

## Access and limitations
Public pages are rendered as HTML for readers and crawlers. The interactive editor and downloads require JavaScript. Word exports use .doc; Markdown exports use .md. ATS compatibility and search visibility are not guaranteed. Templates contain examples, not verified applicant credentials. Personal browser drafts are not part of these public resources.
